meta.source: IM-001 is iMtalii's own Prado TX fleet (from their posts). All other cars, photos, rates and features are illustrative samples for a preview build and must be replaced before launch.

cars.name: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado TX
cars.summary: The Prado TX fleet iMtalii is known for: weddings, VIP events and executive transfers, ready for any terrain.
cars.description:
The Land Cruiser Prado TX is the car iMtalii is known for: a luxury fleet for weddings, VIP events and executive transfers. Dressed in wedding glam for a big day, or sent quietly to collect a guest at the airport, it brings luxury and comfort to every arrival, and it is ready for any terrain.

Book it with chauffeur services and let the day run around you. 24/7 support is always on hand, and nationwide delivery is available. Tell us the occasion, and we'll confirm availability and your quote.
cars.note: Confirmed from iMtalii's own posts (Luxury Land Cruiser Prado TX fleet for weddings, VIP events and executive transfers). Rate, seats and self-drive availability to confirm.

cars.name: Toyota Axio
cars.summary: A neat, frugal sedan that slips through town without fuss, with a chauffeur at the wheel.
cars.description:
Small enough to thread through the CBD and light on its feet in traffic, the Toyota Axio makes short work of a full diary. It is the sensible choice among our sedans, and it wears that well.

With a chauffeur handling the route and the parking, your time stays your own. Settle in, take your calls and step out at each stop feeling unhurried. For everyday journeys around Nairobi, it keeps things simple and comfortable.

cars.name: Toyota Allion
cars.summary: A calm, roomy saloon for daily errands, airport runs and unhurried city meetings.
cars.description:
The Toyota Allion is a quiet companion for the working week. Its cabin is wider than its neat outline suggests, the ride stays settled over Nairobi's busier streets, and everything falls easily to hand.

Choose it when the day calls for composure rather than theatre: a run to the airport, a string of appointments, a relative to collect from across town. Drive it yourself or hand over the keys to a chauffeur and use the back seat to catch up.

cars.name: Toyota Mark X
cars.summary: A rear-wheel-drive Toyota sedan with a sporting edge, driven for you by a chauffeur.
cars.description:
The Toyota Mark X has always had a little more spirit than the sedans around it. Its stance is purposeful, its six-cylinder heart is smooth, and the cabin is finished with an eye for occasion.

With a chauffeur at the wheel, all of that translates into an easy, confident ride across the city. It is a fine way to reach a meeting or a dinner looking composed, with the journey itself taken care of.

cars.name: Mazda CX-5
cars.summary: A stylish compact SUV with a raised view of the road and an interior that feels considered.
cars.description:
Sharp lines outside and a tidy, well-finished cabin inside make the Mazda CX-5 an easy car to like. You sit a little higher than the traffic, the controls feel precise, and the proportions are right for both tight parking and open roads.

It is equally at home on a weekday in Nairobi and on a weekend away. Drive yourself and enjoy it, or book a chauffeur and let someone else mind the road.

cars.name: Subaru Forester
cars.summary: A surefooted all-wheel-drive SUV for trips where the tarmac may run out.
cars.description:
Subaru built the Forester for people who would rather not turn back when the road gets interesting. All-wheel drive comes as standard, the windows are generous, and the view out makes unfamiliar routes easier to read.

With a chauffeur at the wheel, it is a settled choice for upcountry visits and weekends beyond the city. Inside, the cabin stays calm and practical, ready for muddy boots and good company alike.

cars.name: Nissan X-Trail
cars.summary: A practical family SUV with room for luggage, comfortable seats and a willing nature.
cars.description:
The Nissan X-Trail is built for days when plans include bags, children and a change of scenery. There is generous space front and back, a tall driving position, and a relaxed manner that keeps long stretches from feeling long.

Load it up for a family weekend or use it for a week of errands around the city. It is available to drive yourself or with a chauffeur, whichever makes the trip easier.

cars.name: Toyota RAV4
cars.summary: A versatile, adventure-minded crossover that is just as comfortable on the school run.
cars.description:
The Toyota RAV4 has an honest, go-anywhere character that makes it easy to live with. The cabin is spacious, the boot swallows a weekend's luggage, and the driving position gives you a clear, confident view ahead.

Take it out of town for a change of air or keep it for a busy week in Nairobi. Drive it yourself if the road is part of the pleasure, or book a chauffeur if you would prefer to watch the scenery.

cars.name: Mazda Atenza
cars.summary: A sleek Japanese sedan with a flowing silhouette and a cabin that feels a class above.
cars.description:
The Mazda Atenza looks as though it was drawn in a single stroke. Long, low and gracefully proportioned, it arrives with more presence than you might expect, and the leather-lined cabin carries on the thought.

It suits the client lunch and the long afternoon of meetings equally well. Take the wheel and enjoy how neatly it responds, or have a chauffeur drive while you prepare for what comes next.

cars.name: Toyota Crown
cars.summary: Toyota's stately executive sedan, chauffeur-driven and quietly dignified.
cars.description:
The Toyota Crown has a long history of carrying people who have somewhere important to be. It keeps its elegance understated: a poised profile, a hushed cabin and seats that invite you to sit back and let the city pass.

This is a car for the rear seat. Your chauffeur handles the route while you read, rest or prepare your remarks, and you arrive looking as though the traffic never happened.

cars.name: Audi A6
cars.summary: A crisp, technology-rich Audi sedan for those who like their business well pressed.
cars.description:
The Audi A6 has the clean precision of a well-kept boardroom. Sharp lighting, digital instruments and a cabin of soft leather and exact seams give it an air of quiet competence.

Chauffeur-driven, it is a natural fit for the working day, with a smooth ride that lets you finish that last document on the way in. Step out with your jacket uncreased and your attention firmly on the meeting ahead.

cars.name: Mercedes-Benz C-Class
cars.summary: A compact Mercedes-Benz with big-car poise, for driving yourself or being driven.
cars.description:
The Mercedes-Benz C-Class brings the marque's elegance to a size that suits the city. Its cabin borrows from the larger models, with sweeping trim, soft ambient light and a central screen that feels pleasantly modern.

Take the wheel for a day of appointments around Nairobi, or leave the driving to a chauffeur and arrive fresh. It is a poised, approachable way to enjoy a Mercedes-Benz whenever the occasion deserves a little polish.

cars.name: Mercedes-Benz E-Class
cars.summary: The classic executive Mercedes-Benz, serene and supremely well mannered.
cars.description:
Few cars are as closely tied to the idea of arriving well as the Mercedes-Benz E-Class. It rides softly, speaks quietly and fills its cabin with warm light and fine materials.

Booked with a chauffeur, it is the natural car for a senior guest, a board meeting or an evening at a formal dinner. Nothing about it needs explaining, which is precisely why it continues to be chosen for occasions that matter.

cars.name: Lexus ES
cars.summary: A graceful Lexus sedan, whisper-quiet and finished with Japanese attention to detail.
cars.description:
The Lexus ES is a study in calm. It glides rather than drives, and the cabin is finished with the kind of care that reveals itself slowly: a soft stitch here, a well-weighted switch there.

With a chauffeur at the wheel, the rear seat becomes a private room between appointments. It is a gracious way to welcome a guest from the airport or to reach an important meeting feeling rested and ready.

cars.name: Volvo S90
cars.summary: Scandinavian calm on wheels, with a light-filled cabin and elegant, uncluttered design.
cars.description:
The Volvo S90 approaches luxury the Swedish way: with restraint. Clean surfaces, pale light through the glass roof and seats that feel carefully thought through create a cabin that lowers the pulse the moment you sit down.

Chauffeur-driven, it is an ideal place to prepare for a difficult meeting or to decompress after one. Discreet and quietly confident, it suits guests who appreciate good design more than a loud entrance.

cars.name: BMW 5 Series
cars.summary: The driver's executive sedan, sharp and assured, here with a chauffeur to enjoy it for you.
cars.description:
The BMW 5 Series has long been the choice of people who care about how a car feels as well as how it looks. Balanced, responsive and handsomely restrained, it makes even a routine trip seem deliberate.

In the rear seat, that composure becomes pure comfort. Your chauffeur handles the road while ambient light and a fine sound system set the tone, and you arrive with the assurance that every detail has been considered.

cars.name: Jaguar XF
cars.summary: British elegance in sedan form, sleek and tailored, with a chauffeur at the wheel.
cars.description:
The Jaguar XF wears its heritage lightly. A long bonnet, a low roofline and a cabin with the feel of a well-cut suit give it a character quite distinct from its German rivals.

It is the car to choose when you would rather be remembered than merely noticed. Your chauffeur takes care of the road while you enjoy the soft leather and fine sound system, and you step out with quiet confidence.

cars.name: Audi A8
cars.summary: Audi's flagship limousine, cool, composed and quietly packed with technology.
cars.description:
The Audi A8 expresses luxury through intelligence. Everything works with a soft precision, from the matrix headlights to the touch-sensitive controls, and the cabin has the calm, cool order of a very good hotel suite.

In the rear, massaging seats and a smooth air-sprung ride let you recover between engagements. With a chauffeur driving, it is an accomplished choice for visiting dignitaries and anyone who values discretion over display.

cars.name: BMW 7 Series
cars.summary: BMW's grandest sedan, with lounge-like rear seats and an unmistakable sense of arrival.
cars.description:
The BMW 7 Series is a statement delivered in a calm voice. Its long body and imposing grille announce the arrival, while the rear cabin, with lounge seating and a glowing glass roof, keeps the experience entirely private.

Book it chauffeur-driven for the evenings and engagements where the entrance matters. Massage seats ease the journey, and the moment the door opens, it is clear that someone important has come.

cars.name: Lexus LS
cars.summary: Lexus's flagship, crafted with extraordinary care for those who travel in the back.
cars.description:
The Lexus LS is the product of an almost obsessive attention to detail. Hand-finished glass trim, deep semi-aniline leather and rear seats that massage away the day create an atmosphere closer to a private lounge than a car.

Chauffeur-driven by design, it is a car for the guest whose comfort is the whole point. The silence inside is remarkable, and it makes long transfers feel surprisingly short.

cars.name: Porsche Panamera
cars.summary: A low, dramatic Porsche with four proper seats and a real sense of occasion.
cars.description:
The Porsche Panamera is what happens when a sports car learns good manners. It is long, low and unmistakable, and it turns an ordinary drive across town into something people stop to watch.

Inside, four individual seats wrap around you in leather and quiet technology. With a chauffeur at the wheel, it is a striking choice for a gala, a launch or a wedding exit that guests will still be talking about the following morning.

cars.name: Mercedes-Benz GLE
cars.summary: A polished Mercedes-Benz SUV with a floating ride, driven for you by a chauffeur.
cars.description:
The Mercedes-Benz GLE takes the feeling of a fine saloon and raises it above the traffic. Soft nappa leather, sweeping screens and a ride that smooths over the rough patches make the cabin a pleasant place to spend an hour or three.

As a chauffeur-driven car, it suits guests you want to look after properly. Expect a calm arrival, plenty of room for luggage and the unmistakable presence of a Mercedes-Benz.

cars.name: Audi Q7
cars.summary: A broad-shouldered seven-seat Audi that brings the whole party along in comfort.
cars.description:
The Audi Q7 solves a familiar problem with style: how to bring everyone and still arrive looking composed. Three rows of seats sit inside a cabin of crisp German design, and the ride stays calm however full the car may be.

Use it for the family gathering, the visiting delegation or the bridal party's second car. Drive yourself, or let a chauffeur manage the road while the conversation carries on behind.

cars.name: BMW X5
cars.summary: A poised, athletic luxury SUV that makes every journey feel well spent.
cars.description:
The BMW X5 has the rare gift of feeling both substantial and light on its feet. Sit up high behind that familiar grille, and the road opens up with a clarity that makes driving a pleasure again.

Whether you take the keys yourself or sit behind a chauffeur, the glass roof and well-appointed cabin keep the mood bright. It is a strong presence at a meeting, an event or a getaway from the city.

cars.name: Land Rover Discovery
cars.summary: A capable seven-seat Land Rover, equally at home at the lodge and the hotel entrance.
cars.description:
The Land Rover Discovery carries a certain easy authority wherever it goes. Three rows of seats, a commanding view and the brand's long experience away from the tarmac make it a natural partner for bigger journeys.

With a chauffeur in charge, the whole party can relax and watch the landscape change. It is well suited to family trips and upcountry visits, and it looks entirely at ease when the journey ends at a smart hotel.

cars.name: Lexus RX
cars.summary: A serene Japanese luxury crossover, with a beautifully hushed cabin and warm craftsmanship.
cars.description:
Few cars do quiet as convincingly as the Lexus RX. Doors close with a soft thud, the road noise fades, and you are left in a cabin of supple leather and careful detail. It is luxury without any need to raise its voice.

It makes an elegant choice for airport collections and family occasions, and it is just as agreeable for a long afternoon behind the wheel. Book it as a self-drive, or with a chauffeur for complete ease.

cars.name: Range Rover Vogue
cars.summary: The original luxury SUV: stately, serene and at ease on any road you choose.
cars.description:
The Range Rover Vogue occupies a place of its own. High, upright and beautifully detailed, it treats a red carpet and a rutted track with exactly the same unruffled poise.

With a chauffeur at the wheel, the rear of the cabin is one of the calmest places to watch the country pass by. Soft leather, a glass roof and a floating ride combine to make arrivals feel like an event, wherever they happen to be.

cars.name: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado
cars.summary: The dependable safari favourite, with seven seats with a chauffeur at the wheel.
cars.description:
The Toyota Land Cruiser Prado has earned its reputation one difficult road at a time. Sturdy and well mannered, it takes rough tracks in its stride and still offers a comfortable, leather-lined cabin once the dust has settled.

Book it chauffeur-driven for a safari or a long trip upcountry, and leave the road to someone else. With seats for the whole group and room for the luggage, it keeps adventure feeling civilised from start to finish.

cars.name: Nissan Patrol
cars.summary: A commanding full-size 4x4 with V8 authority and space to stretch out.
cars.description:
The Nissan Patrol is a large vehicle that makes no apology for it. Its V8 gathers pace without effort, the cabin has space to spare, and its long off-road pedigree brings a reassuring calm to difficult routes.

Chauffeur-driven, it is a fine choice for a group heading well beyond the city, or for an entrance that needs real presence. Rear entertainment keeps younger passengers occupied while the miles slide quietly by.
